custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit and See Financial Data but without Part Library & Inventory — Delete, so user B can create and edit parts but cannot delete them.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user B, so both users' screens can be seen side by side.
  • Start both windows on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154780-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154780-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • A cycle count is running when the Inventory list shows a Count column with Save and Cancel above it; click Cancel to stop it.
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • To create a custom role: Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role; in Choose a template click Skip; type the Role Name; switch on Parts Department, then tick the boxes the setup names on its three rows, Part sales, Part Library and Inventory, and Vendor and order management (each has View, Create & Edit and Delete); See Financial Data is under Cross-Cutting Toggles; then click Create. (The setup above writes these boxes as, for example, Part Library & Inventory — View, which is the View box on the Part Library and Inventory row.)
  • User B: the QA site's sign-in screen offers only Admin and Tech, so user B is the shared Tech sign-in given role B for this test. Signed in as Admin: Settings, then Staff in the left menu; click Search, type tech@shopview.com, click the edit icon at the end of Tech ShopView's row, pick role B under Role and click Save & Close. Then, in the second (private) window, choose Tech on the sign-in screen. When the test is finished, set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician the same way, because other testers use that sign-in.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Admin's menu lists Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export, in that order: the entry exists on this build.

Step 2:

  • The menu closes.

Step 3:

  • User B's menu lists Cycle count and Export only.
  • There is no Deactivate parts entry.

Step 4:

  • Cycle count starts for user B (the count toolbar and Count boxes appear): Cycle count needs nothing more than Create & Edit.

Step 5:

  • The count ends and the toolbar is back to normal.

Step 6:

  • The Inactive tab is selected in window 2.

Step 7:

  • User B's menu lists Cycle count and Export only.
  • There is no Activate parts entry.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S8-R3: “A user without that permission does not see the "Deactivate parts" entry in the Inventory actions menu.”
  • S8-R4: “That user does not see the "Activate parts" entry on the Inactive tab.”
  • S8-R5: “The actions menu needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission. Its Cycle count and Export entries need nothing more. Only the bulk status entry also needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "4.1 The actions menu". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

The design's own words:

  • “"Deactivate parts" sits between Cycle count and Export while the Active tab shows (S2-R1, S2-R2). A user without the Delete permission does not see it (S8-R3).”
